title: Desktop shows four KPI tiles in a row and two count tiles below
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1280 pixels wide (e.g. a 1920 x 1080 monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Look at the arrangement of the tiles without scrolling sideways.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The first row holds four tiles side by side, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
  • The second row, below it, holds two tiles side by side: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12.
